# Funding disclosure regression fixture

## Background

This introductory sentence carries no citations at all and is long enough to be measured on its own.

### Sources of funding

The foundation partnered with three universities on this cohort [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
A second agency matched the first grant for the full study period [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
Corporate sponsors contributed equipment without steering the design [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
Regional funds covered fieldwork in every participating district [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
An independent trust paid for the open access publication fees [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
University seed money supported the pilot phase before external awards [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
A charitable endowment funded the follow up interviews and transcription [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
Government scholarships supported graduate students on the project team [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
Hospital research accounts financed the clinical data collection costs [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
A donor advised fund covered statistical consulting and data audits [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
European grants supported the cross border comparison work packages [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].

Private philanthropies paid for community engagement and outreach events [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
Municipal budgets supported the school site coordination roles [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
